payload.reason: The evidence indicates that categories exist across languages and cultures, suggesting that languages share categories based on common cognitive structures and properties.

claims.text: Categories such as animal or furniture are fundamental cognitive building blocks that exist across cultures and languages, allowing efficient representation of the world.
Language influences the emergence and representation of categories, indicating that while categories are shared, their manifestations can differ across languages.
Empirical studies show that meaningful categories can be learned from natural language text across multiple languages, demonstrating shared cognitive structures.
